description: Company claim inventory. First 3 company-record calls per UTC day per client are free (result includes free_allowance). After that: $0.01 USDC on Base via x402 v2; without payment this returns the x402 PaymentRequired challenge and no data is returned until payment settles. Unknown companies return not-found and are never charged.

entity_ref.description: entity_ref returned by lansary_search_companies; used if reference_token is absent.

payment_signature.description: Base64 x402 PaymentPayload (the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value), for clients that cannot set _meta["x402/payment"].

name: lansary_company_claims
title: Company claim inventory (3 free/day, then $0.01 via x402)
